notes: 15 synthetic FIT HANU campus IT scenarios for the midterm/final demo. `expected_behavior` is a qualitative description of correct reasoning against the updated rules.json — not a hard-coded answer key. Build your own infer()/explain() against rules.json.

scenarios.description: Student connects to HANU_Student but the captive portal login page does not appear, and repeated logins redirect back to the same page.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Only CAUSE01 (captive portal session expired or cookie blocked) should fire via R001 and R003.
scenarios.reasoning_probe: Show every rule that fired for this scenario and confirm they all agree on one cause.

scenarios.description: Shared printer in P.210 Nhà C shows Offline. Print jobs queue but never print.
scenarios.expected_behavior: CAUSE13 (toner empty or hardware fault) and CAUSE14 (driver mismatch) may both fire (ambiguous scenario).
scenarios.reasoning_probe: Which rule IDs fired? How many distinct causes does the system return? What additional symptom would disambiguate between CAUSE13 and CAUSE14?

scenarios.description: A student registered for AIN301 via the credit registration portal but the course does not appear on FIT LMS (lms.hanu.edu.vn).
scenarios.expected_behavior: Only CAUSE04 (student not enrolled in the LMS section after registration) should fire via R010.
scenarios.reasoning_probe: What is the minimal symptom subset that still triggers CAUSE04 alone?

scenarios.description: HANU_Student connection drops repeatedly inside Lab C1. Same behaviour on different laptops.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Both CAUSE02 (driver) and CAUSE03 (AP overload) should fire (R005 and R007 both trigger). The system should surface both and recommend follow-up questions.
scenarios.reasoning_probe: What one additional question would you ask the student to distinguish CAUSE02 from CAUSE03? How would the answer change the inference?

scenarios.description: A student cannot log into portal.hanu.edu.vn, and the training portal also shows the account as suspended.
scenarios.expected_behavior: CAUSE11 (account locked after failed attempts) should be the primary cause. The system should explain both rules that fire (R027 and R028).
scenarios.reasoning_probe: Would the presence of SYM21 (2FA code not received) change the set of triggered causes? Which new rule would fire?

scenarios.description: Student reports 'I have a problem with FIT LMS' but provides no specific symptom.
scenarios.expected_behavior: No rules fire. System should report 'insufficient evidence' and ask clarifying questions to narrow down to SYM07–SYM11.
scenarios.reasoning_probe: Which symptom, if added, would produce the most informative (single-cause) inference? Which would create the most ambiguity?

scenarios.description: Printer shows Offline (SYM22), but staff report faded output (SYM25), and a job printed successfully from the instructor's PC (SYM26). The first and third symptoms are in partial contradiction (offline vs. able to print from one PC).
scenarios.expected_behavior: System should flag the SYM22/SYM26 tension (printer cannot be offline and printing simultaneously) and report ambiguous evidence, listing both CAUSE13 and CAUSE14 as candidate causes while noting the inconsistency.
scenarios.reasoning_probe: Which pair of symptoms is contradictory? What would a real technician do to resolve this before running inference?

scenarios.description: Lab C2 workstation shows a GRUB rescue prompt on boot. Ubuntu will not load.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Only CAUSE07 (GRUB misconfigured) should fire via R017.
scenarios.reasoning_probe: Is the student permitted to repair GRUB themselves? What action does the system recommend?

scenarios.description: Lab C1 workstation shows no network icon and cannot be assigned an IP address.
scenarios.expected_behavior: CAUSE08 (LAN cable unplugged or NIC failed) should fire via R019.
scenarios.reasoning_probe: Does adding SYM13 (keyboard unresponsive) change the set of fired causes? Why or why not?

scenarios.description: Projector in room C202 shows a blue screen when the student connects a laptop via HDMI.
scenarios.expected_behavior: CAUSE09 (input source not set or faulty HDMI cable) should fire via R022.
scenarios.reasoning_probe: What is the cheapest and fastest action to verify CAUSE09 without specialist tools?

scenarios.description: Student's @hanu.edu.vn email password has expired and the self-service reset email does not arrive.
scenarios.expected_behavior: CAUSE10 (HANU account password expired) fires via R025. System should advise visiting P.210 Nhà C with student ID.
scenarios.reasoning_probe: Would adding SYM21 (2FA not received) change the fired rules? List the new rule IDs.

scenarios.description: Student cannot submit a lab report on FIT LMS because of a file-size-exceeded error.
scenarios.expected_behavior: CAUSE06 (file exceeds LMS upload limit) fires via R015.
scenarios.reasoning_probe: What is the immediate workaround the system recommends? Does the diagnosis change if SYM11 (deadline mismatch) is also present?

scenarios.description: HANU_Student connects on the student's phone but not on the laptop.
scenarios.expected_behavior: CAUSE02 (driver issue) fires via R006. System should recommend updating the wireless driver.
scenarios.reasoning_probe: What information about the laptop model or OS version would strengthen or weaken this diagnosis?

scenarios.description: Student's Microsoft 365 shows 'Unlicensed' after a recent HANU password change.
scenarios.expected_behavior: CAUSE12 (M365 HANU licence not assigned) fires via R030.
scenarios.reasoning_probe: Why might a password change cause the licence to go unlicensed? What architectural reason does R031 capture?

scenarios.description: FIT LMS logs the student out every few minutes, and the submission deadline displayed does not match the announced one.
scenarios.expected_behavior: CAUSE05 (session timeout / cookie blocked) fires via R013 and R014.
scenarios.reasoning_probe: Do both SYM09 and SYM11 need to be present to fire CAUSE05? What is the minimum symptom set?
